query.description: 대표 Device 의 Sub Device 목록
query.commandtext: SELECT SUB_DEVICE_ID, REMARK, CREATE_USER, TO_CHAR(CREATE_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATE_TIME FROM TQP_GDS_MAP_SUB_DEVICE WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND DEVICE_ID = :device_id ORDER BY UPPER(SUB_DEVICE_ID)

query.description: Factory 의 Sub Device 전체 (저장 전 다른 대표 등록 확인)
query.commandtext: SELECT SUB_DEVICE_ID, DEVICE_ID FROM TQP_GDS_MAP_SUB_DEVICE WHERE FACTORY = :factory

query.description: 다른 데이터의 Device 이름 -> READY 대표 Map Device (Sub 등록 우선, 다음 같은 이름 Map)
query.commandtext: SELECT DEVICE_ID, MATCH_TYPE FROM (SELECT M.DEVICE_ID, 'SUB' AS MATCH_TYPE, 1 AS PRIORITY FROM TQP_GDS_MAP_SUB_DEVICE S JOIN TQP_GDS_MAP M ON M.FACTORY = S.FACTORY AND M.DEVICE_ID = S.DEVICE_ID WHERE S.FACTORY = :sub_factory AND UPPER(S.SUB_DEVICE_ID) = UPPER(:sub_device_id) AND M.MAP_STATUS = 'READY' UNION ALL SELECT M.DEVICE_ID, 'SELF' AS MATCH_TYPE, 2 AS PRIORITY FROM TQP_GDS_MAP M WHERE M.FACTORY = :map_factory AND UPPER(M.DEVICE_ID) = UPPER(:map_device_id) AND M.MAP_STATUS = 'READY' ORDER BY 3, 1) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

query.description: 대표 Device 의 Sub Device 전체 삭제 (저장 = 삭제 후 일괄 등록)
query.commandtext: DELETE FROM TQP_GDS_MAP_SUB_DEVICE WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND DEVICE_ID = :device_id
INSERT INTO TQP_GDS_MAP_SUB_DEVICE (FACTORY, SUB_DEVICE_ID, DEVICE_ID, REMARK, CREATE_USER) VALUES (:factory, :sub_device_id, :device_id, :remark, :create_user)
